rawContent: I've worked a couple bar-time jobs in my day. I understood on some level why my female coworkers needed to be walked to their cars nightly. But #MeToo has brought some clarity to an issue that my privilege didn't let me see.

Hey, I've got a little something to add to the #MeToo discussion. 

A lot of people are conflating kinks and assault. There's a HUGE difference and it's this little thing called 'consent.' 

We've had this worked out for some time.
